title: Book Four Star Flat | Condo Rental in Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Four Star Flat is a beautiful 2-bed, 2-bath condo rental in Rosemary Beach with a welcoming coastal theme and cozy vibe. Click here to book your stay!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

The first thing you’ll notice when walking into this 2-bed, 2-bath home is the amount of color that has been put into the décor. You’ll find bluish grey walls covered with nautical-themed items and décor, all colored various hues of blue. Even the carpet is a wash of blues, creating the illusion that you’re walking upon the ocean waves. In the living room, you’ll find a lovely sitting area complete with a television for those days where going out just doesn’t sound as enticing as lying around getting lost in your favorite TV show or movie.

Next to the sitting area, you’ll find the dining room with a circular wooden table, complete with blue tinted plates which perfectly match the rest of the décor. Thanks to the open floor design, it doesn’t take but a glance to locate the kitchen with beautiful cherry red cabinets and granite countertops. It truly is a kitchen you’d be glad to cook a feast within—plus it comes equipped with all the essentials, ensuring that you can whip up whatever delicious tickles your fancy.

As you make your way past the kitchen, following the flowing blue rug, you’ll find the two bedrooms, which are just as colorful and charming as the living areas. You’ll find the master bedroom with a comfy king bed and a private bathroom sporting dual his and hers sinks, as well as a walk-in shower. Across the way you’ll find the guest bedroom with a queen bed and a shared bathroom in the hallway. This is of course in addition to the wonderful patio that overlooks the grass and trees; it is sure to be the perfect place to relax with a cool drink and maybe enjoy reading a book in the rejuvenating fresh air.

Parking behind building.
Why not take that vacation you and everyone in your family has been whishing to occur for quite some time, and why not enjoy said trip in what is truly a home and where you can not only relax and unwind, but truly feel safe and welcomed? If you are ready to let those daydreams become memory, make sure you contact Rosemary Beach at (866) 348-8952 or book your stay in Four Stars Flat today!

** This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
